scores.description: What your heuristic/model predicted, in item order.
scores.title: Scores

outcomes.description: What actually happened for the same items, same order. Views, revenue, conversions, clicks — whatever the score is meant to predict.
outcomes.title: Outcomes

gate_threshold.description: If you currently act on scores above some value, pass it here and the report will tell you what that gate actually buys.
gate_threshold.title: Gate Threshold

higher_score_means_better.description: Set false if a LOWER score is supposed to mean a better outcome.
higher_score_means_better.title: Higher Score Means Better

n.description: Usable pairs after dropping non-finite values.
n.title: N

pearson_r.description: Linear correlation, −1..1. Null when a series has no variance.
pearson_r.title: Pearson R

spearman_r.description: Rank correlation — catches monotone-but-curved relationships Pearson misses.
spearman_r.title: Spearman R

noise_floor.description: |r| below this is indistinguishable from zero at this n (≈2/√n).
noise_floor.title: Noise Floor

verdict.description: predictive | weak | noise | ANTI-CORRELATED | insufficient-data | no-variance
verdict.title: Verdict

top_vs_bottom_decile_lift.description: Mean outcome of the top-scored decile ÷ the bottom. 1.0 = the score sorts nothing.
top_vs_bottom_decile_lift.title: Top Vs Bottom Decile Lift

deciles.description: Decile table, so you can see the shape rather than trust one number.
deciles.title: Deciles

gate_kept_mean.description: Mean outcome of items your gate keeps.
gate_kept_mean.title: Gate Kept Mean

gate_dropped_mean.description: Mean outcome of items it drops.
gate_dropped_mean.title: Gate Dropped Mean

gate_verdict.description: What the gate is actually doing.
gate_verdict.title: Gate Verdict

warnings.description: Things that make the numbers less trustworthy than they look.
warnings.title: Warnings
